actions.action: Place the plant in bright shade with no direct sun for week 1
In week 2, move the plant into 1-2 hours of direct morning sun, then back to shade
In weeks 3-4, add about an hour of direct sun every few days
Check the leaves for bleached or crispy white patches
If the leaves show bleaching, move the plant back to shade for a few days
Check that the soil is fully dry before watering
Water the soil, not the leaves, when it is dry
Keep the plant out of heavy rain or make sure the basket drains well
Set fallen leaves on dry soil to root

reason: The answer treats the plant as healthy and focuses on acclimating it to sun without burning, which is the confirmed problem; its gradual acclimation plan would also avoid sunburn and is not harmful, though it is more cautious than the 'just put it outside' advice that worked.
